newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli shekel unchanged against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Israeli shekel unchanged against dollar.

text.p: The Israeli shekel closed unchanged against the dollar on Tuesday, unaffected by the cabinet approval on Monday of a second round of cuts in the 1997 budget, dealers said.

"The session opened with strong demand for the dollar, but when the dollar reached 3.29 shekels the business sector started converting dollars into shekels and the dollar fell to the opening level," said a dealer at Israel Discount Bank.
The dealer said the cabinet approval -- of 1.2 billion shekels in spending cuts and 600 million shekels in new income -- had no impact on trading.

The representative rate for the dollar was fixed at 3.2820 shekels, unchanged from Monday. The basket, composed of the dollar, mark, pound sterling, French franc and yen, was fixed at 3.6620 shekels against 3.6617 on Monday.
On the crosses the shekel traded against the yen at 2.8988 shekels per 100 yen against 2.8971 on Monday and against the mark at 2.1120 shekels against 2.1142 on Monday.
In late afternoon the dollar was trading at 3.2825 shekels.
